LanguageData.MS_ConstructionSupplyUse: Automatically supplies construction materials within {0} cells. Colonists perform construction.
LanguageData.MS_Status_MultipleCores: multiple control cores; storage operations and production suspended
LanguageData.MS_UnitTransfer_Desc: Cancel reservations for items in this unit and move as much as possible into other storage units on the same network. Fill compatible partial stacks before using empty slots. Items that cannot be moved remain in this unit.
LanguageData.MS_UnitTransfer_Empty: This unit has no items to transfer.
LanguageData.MS_ManualWithdrawalOnly: Ordinary hauling cannot withdraw stored items. Auto-restocking shelves place selected items for colonists to collect.
LanguageData.MS_ConduitAlreadyPresent: A storage conduit or its construction plan is already here.
LanguageData.MS_UI_OpenDesc: View all items in connected storage units and withdraw selected quantities around the core.
LanguageData.MS_UI_Selected: Selected: {0} entries, {1} items (including selections hidden by filters).
LanguageData.MS_UI_ForbidTip: Prevents immediate restocking, but also prevents ordinary use.
LanguageData.MS_UI_Hint: Ordinary hauling cannot withdraw items; auto-restocking shelves place selected items for colonists to collect.
LanguageData.MS_UI_Result: Placed: {0}; awaiting placement: {1}; not withdrawn: {2}. Pending items are saved and retried automatically.
LanguageData.MS_UI_Refreshed: The network or inventory changed. The list was refreshed and withdrawal quantities were reset.
LanguageData.MS_UI_TotalTip: Total quantity held in the storage network.
LanguageData.MS_UI_AvailableTip: Quantity available for withdrawal, excluding hauling and collection reservations.
LanguageData.MS_UI_SelectedTip: Quantity to place around the core on confirmation.
LanguageData.MS_UI_RemainingTip: Quantity remaining in the network after this withdrawal.
LanguageData.MS_UI_QuantityTip: Right arrows increase withdrawal; left arrows decrease it. Hold the left mouse button and drag across arrow buttons to adjust multiple rows. Each row is adjusted once per drag.
LanguageData.MS_ReceiverUse: Uses the connected core's filter and priority. Eligible items on its surface are automatically sent to storage units.
LanguageData.MS_SettingsAccessibilityNotice: The following options modify vanilla code. If enabling them causes errors or has no effect, this indicates a conflict with another mod: both this mod and the other mod modify vanilla code.
LanguageData.MS_SettingsTidySupplyShelfHelp: Improve how items are displayed on restocking shelves.
LanguageData.MS_SettingsWorkbenchUnlockModeHelp: Spend construction materials to unlock workbenches before adding their recipes. Workbenches with no material cost are unlocked automatically. Unlocks are shared throughout the current save. Disabling this mode makes all researched recipes available and preserves recorded unlocks.
LanguageData.MS_SettingsPerformanceNotice: We recommend keeping the initial defaults, as this mod already performs very well.
LanguageData.MS_SettingsUnitSlotsHelp: Range: 1–10000. Default: 64. Applies immediately to existing and new storage units. Lowering the limit preserves stored items. Units above capacity cannot accept new stacks, but compatible partial stacks can still be filled.
LanguageData.MS_SettingsRefreshHelp: Refresh times: 1–60 seconds at normal game speed, default 1. Longer intervals reduce periodic checks but delay responses. Switching modes preserves both sets of values. Immediate supply commands still run immediately.
LanguageData.MS_SettingsCraftingMaterialRecheckHelp: How often to retry after materials are missing. Set to 0 to check on every attempt.
LanguageData.MS_DebugFill_SelectUnit: Select a single storage unit on the current map first.
LanguageData.MS_DebugFill_NoMaterials: None of the resources used by this tool are loaded.
